title: AI Label Review Queue by Animal Class
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trailcam:label
| stats count(eval(review_status="pending")) as pending_reviews count as labels by animal_class
| sort 0 - pending_reviews
description: Ranks animal classess by manual AI label review queue.
value: A class-level review queue helps you spend manual effort where the model is generating the most unresolved work.
implementation: Send manual AI label review queue events to `index=personal` and keep `animal_class` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of manual AI label review queue by animal classes.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers which animal classess stand out most for manual AI label review queue.
